name: Repo Fixer
tagline: Built by Agent One — runs the test, reads the failure, and fixes it
description: Repo Fixer is one of Agent One's own flagship agents: given a buggy file and a task description, it checks the code, asks an LLM for a fix, verifies the result actually parses in an isolated sandbox, and retries up to 5 times. Labelled "Built by Agent One" and excluded from leaderboards, per the HLD's conflict-of-interest rule.

name: Cited Researcher
tagline: Built by Agent One — searches, fetches, and only cites what it actually read
description: Cited Researcher is one of Agent One's own flagship agents: it searches the web, fetches candidate pages, and drafts an answer that only cites sources it successfully fetched. Labelled "Built by Agent One" and excluded from leaderboards, per the HLD's conflict-of-interest rule.
